findings.title: Orientation inside accountability
findings.claim: A person's readable account can be seen within an orientation that is actively held: the wider call to stand firm and not follow desire places distinct deeds inside a shared gathering.
findings.mechanism: The focus's imām carries the relation of guidance and following. 42:15 joins steadfastness, refusal to follow desires, revealed scripture, distinct deeds, and God's gathering; its contact with the focus's group-indexed summons and each person's book makes orientation part of what is accountable.
findings.reader_payoff: Reading the book becomes part of a lived direction and its deeds, not an isolated inspection detached from how one follows.
findings.containment: The retained connection supports orientation alongside personal accounting. It does not establish the HFT summary's separate blindness or anti-substitution sequence, nor claim that physical perception is a condition of reading.

epistemic.reason: The HFT nomination is unbound, but the narrower relation is grounded by the exact supplied 42:15 Arabic connection and returns through the focus-attested guide branch.

findings.title: Register and smallest measure
findings.claim: The focus's personal book can be read as an inspectable written account whose wider record gathers deeds and traces, while its measure of justice reaches down to a thread.
findings.mechanism: The focus imām meets a prior book called imām and a wider use in which deeds and traces are gathered in an encompassing imam. Its kitāb meets inscription and self-reading connections; its fatīl meets an exact repeated no-wronging formula and full recompense. These contacts align the organizing register, written account, and smallest stated measure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can follow a line from the reference that gathers an account, to the book a person reads, to the smallest amount that justice does not omit.
findings.containment: The source/register use is a connected possibility, not proof that the focus imām denotes a book or causally generates actions. Other guide and way readings remain available; the unsupported perceptual inventory is not carried.

epistemic.reason: The source is an unbound HFT synthesis, but the retained register, written-text, and fine-measure relations each have independent supplied connection targets and exact focus carriers.
